market_question: Will US withdraw from NATO before 2027?
reasoning: Trump's return to the presidency with a skeptical view on NATO raises the chance of a formal withdrawal notice, despite recent legislation requiring congressional approval. The resolution criteria that any notice (even if later blocked) counts as Yes further supports a ~12% probability, above the market's 8.6%.
evidence_points: Trump has repeatedly threatened to leave NATO if allies don't increase defense spending, making a formal notice plausible.
The FY2024 NDAA includes a provision requiring a two-thirds Senate vote to withdraw, creating legal obstacles but not preventing a notice attempt.
Resolution rules state that any official notice of denunciation qualifies, regardless of judicial or congressional halts.
sources_consulted: Trump interviews on NATO (e.g., 'I would not protect you' comments, 2024 campaign)
FY2024 National Defense Authorization Act, Section 1250
Polymarket market description for resolution criteria
